reference_product: OnRobot RG2 with standard EPDM fingertips
rights_review: Official publicly accessible datasheet and product photography inspected. No explicit reproduction restriction found in complete extracted datasheet text. Facts used as dimensions; no OEM image, drawing, CAD, mesh, logo, or texture redistributed. Photos used for visual inspection only. No restricted manual used.
legacy_contract: Joint graph, origins, limits, mimic rules, mount frame and mesh paths are unchanged from the earlier model. 2026-10-10: the TCP moved to the closed-pose centre of the visible boots (217.1 mm from mount) and box/pivot-cylinder collisions now enclose each link's visual. The legacy closedLength is a shoulder-to-bare-tip datum, not the visual height.
estimates: All shape curves, fillets, cover thicknesses and subdivisions
Bracket/QC geometry and screw locations; not a functional mating interface
Arm profile thicknesses, depth layering, bearings and safety-switch covers
Closed visible mount-to-tip height; not an OEM dimension
Safety-switch guard distal relief independently added to clear supporting shafts under preserved legacy kinematics; not a verified OEM cover shape
excluded: Functional safety switch, exact mating interface, cable and dynamics
known_mismatches: The fixed TCP equals the boot centre only in the closed pose; the pads swing towards the mount as the gripper opens
Carrier lower-axle ends stand up to 2.9 mm outside the carrier box, inside the moment-arm plates
Legacy shoulder-to-bare-tip dimension was previously treated as mount-to-pad endpoint
Body/arm and carrier/truss collisions overlap at the designed pivots in every pose
